stories.title: Cremlino, 'l'avvertimento su Kaliningrad non era una dichiarazione conflittuale'

en.title: Kremlin: 'warning on Kaliningrad was not a conflictual statement'
en.summary: Kremlin spokesman Dmitry Peskov stated that a previous warning regarding Kaliningrad should not be interpreted as a declaration of conflict.

stories.title: Setta nel Torinese, dal Maestro anche violenze sessuali su minori

en.title: Sect in Turin area: Leader also committed sexual violence against minors
en.summary: A 59-year-old sect leader in the Turin region exercised total control over victims and allegedly promised to heal them while perpetrating sexual abuse against children.

stories.title: Drone russo colpisce una scuola a Kiev, strage sfiorata, illesi i bambini

en.title: Russian drone strikes school in Kyiv, mass casualties narrowly avoided, children unharmed
en.summary: A Russian drone hit a school in Kyiv with children inside, but they were unharmed as they were sheltered in an air raid shelter at the time of impact.

stories.title: Napoli, il latitante nel doppiofondo dell’armadio: così i carabinieri arrestano Del Prete

en.title: Naples: fugitive in wardrobe false bottom; how carabinieri arrested Del Prete
en.summary: Giuseppe Del Prete, a suspected high-ranking member of the Mazzarella criminal clan wanted since March, was arrested in his Naples home where carabinieri found him hidden in a false-bottomed wardrobe compartment. He faces serious charges including mafia association and drug trafficking conspiracy.

stories.title: Alto Adige, una mucca cade nella piscina del wellness hotel e viene salvata dai Vigili del Fuoco

en.title: Alto Adige, a cow falls into the wellness hotel swimming pool and is rescued by firefighters
en.summary: A cow fell into a swimming pool at a wellness hotel in Alto Adige and was rescued by firefighters.

stories.title: Napoli, arrestato Giuseppe Del Prete, boss del clan Mazzarella: si nascondeva nel doppiofondo dell’armadio

en.title: Naples, Giuseppe Del Prete arrested, boss of the Mazzarella clan: he was hiding in the armoire's false bottom
en.summary: Giuseppe Del Prete, a boss of the Mazzarella crime clan, was arrested in Naples after being found hiding in a concealed compartment within a piece of furniture.

stories.title: Dentro la X2, un giro sulla montagna russa chiusa per sempre dopo le denunce per danni cerebrali

en.title: Inside the X2, a ride on the roller coaster closed forever after reports of brain damage
en.summary: The X2 roller coaster at Six Flags Magic Mountain in California has been permanently closed after more than twenty years of operation, following lawsuits alleging serious brain injuries from riders and a death in 2022.

stories.title: Scoperta una setta ad Almese: tra yoga e meditazione abusi sessuali e violenze

en.title: A sect discovered in Almese: sexual abuse and violence amid yoga and meditation
en.summary: Carabinieri arrested a 59-year-old man in the Almese area as part of an operation targeting a group that conducted yoga and meditation activities while allegedly committing sexual abuse, enslavement, and fraud.

stories.title: Usa, la Corte Suprema dà il via libera all’esecuzione di Christa Pike, ma lei sopravvive a due iniezioni. Ricoverata in ospedale

en.title: USA, Supreme Court approves execution of Christa Pike, but she survives two injections. Hospitalized
en.summary: A 50-year-old woman convicted of murder committed as a teenager survived two lethal injections after the Supreme Court cleared her execution. Her lawyers filed an emergency motion to halt the procedure.

stories.title: Vittorio Sgarbi ricoverato al Gemelli in terapia intensiva

en.title: Vittorio Sgarbi hospitalized at Gemelli in intensive care
en.summary: Art critic and former undersecretary for Culture Vittorio Sgarbi, 74, is hospitalized in intensive care in serious condition. He had previously been treated at the same hospital for severe depression.

stories.title: Vittorio Sgarbi ricoverato in terapia intensiva a Roma

en.title: Vittorio Sgarbi hospitalized in intensive care in Rome
en.summary: Vittorio Sgarbi has been admitted to the intensive care unit at Gemelli Hospital in Rome and is reportedly in serious condition.

stories.title: Vittorio Sgarbi ricoverato al Gemelli in terapia intensiva. La figlia Evelina: “Tragico epilogo”

en.title: Vittorio Sgarbi hospitalized at Gemelli in intensive care. Daughter Evelina: "Tragic ending"
en.summary: Art critic Vittorio Sgarbi has been hospitalized in intensive care, with his daughter describing the situation as a tragic ending. The hospital confirmed the news.

stories.title: Silicon Box, via libera di Invitalia all’investimento da 3,2 miliardi a Novara

en.title: Silicon Box, Invitalia approves 3.2 billion euro investment in Novara
en.summary: Invitalia approved a major investment in the Silicon Box project in Novara, with 1.3 billion euros in public funding allocated. The initiative aims to accelerate permits and begin construction in spring.

en.title: Mechanical engineering hits new record abroad
en.summary: Mechanical engineering exports are reaching new peaks in 2026, with major markets including the United States, China, France, Germany, Saudi Arabia, the United Kingdom, and Spain.

stories.title: Nel cuore di Roma il secondo hotel Kimpton in Italia

en.title: Second Kimpton hotel in Italy opens in Rome's heart
en.summary: IHG Hotels & Resorts is opening Rome's second Kimpton hotel, located in the city center, with an opening planned for 2029.

stories.title: Ai e sicurezza informatica sottovalutate: un’azienda su 4 non fa formazione

en.title: AI and cybersecurity underestimated: one in four companies lacks training
en.summary: An Experis survey of 1,930 IT managers found that many companies are underestimating the importance of artificial intelligence and cybersecurity training.

stories.title: Legami, nel 2025 investiti 2,3 milioni nella sostenibilità

en.title: Legami invests 2.3 million in sustainability in 2025
en.summary: Legami increased sustainability investments to 2.3 million in 2025, more than 60 percent above the planned 1.4 million, focusing on environment, people, and community.
